notes.title: Maj V1.2
notes.content:
Bricks Survivors Update – 07/01/2025
A massive update is here! Get ready for more weapons, evolving terrain, a new explosive skill, and a mysterious new planet. Let’s break it all down:


[hr][/hr]

⚔️ New Features & Improvements
5 Equipment Slots
 You can now equip up to 5 weapons during a run. Time to get creative with your builds!

Expanded Terrain
 The battlefield now grows as the game progresses, especially in Endless Mode, giving you more room—and more threats.

New Planet: Neptune 🌌
 A brand-new world with unstable terrain that shifts in real time. Stay alert and keep moving!

New Boost: Power Expansion
 Increases the size of your special attack effects.

New Skill: The Bomb
 A powerful area-of-effect attack, unlockable through permanent upgrades.

Background Overhaul
 All environments have been visually reworked for better clarity and atmosphere.

General Optimization
 Overall performance has been improved.



[hr][/hr]

⚖️ Balance Changes🔫 Chaos Gun
Fire rate (in seconds):

4s → 3.5s

3.5s → 3s

3s → 2.5s

2.5s → 2s

2s → 1.5s

🛡️ Chaos Turret
Fire rate (in seconds):

3s → 2.75s

2.5s → 2.25s

2s → 1.75s

1.5s → 1.25s

1s → 0.75s

🔥 Multi Laser
Activation chance (%):

7% → 4%

14% → 8%

21% → 12%

28% → 16%

35% → 20%


🟨 Yellow Armor
Cooldown time (in seconds):

1.5s → 1s

1s → 0.75s

0.75s → 0.5s

0.5s → 0.25s

0.25s → 0.1s


🟥 Red Armor
Damage bonus per level:

2 → 3


💥 Missiles
Area damage increased: 50% → 70%


🚀 Upgrade Speed
Max level increased: 10 → 20
⚙️ Versatility Boost
Max level increased to 5, allowing more flexibility in your builds.
🎯 Concentrated Power
Charge count reduced: 20 → 15 (for tighter power management and balance)






[hr][/hr]


💬 Thanks for all your feedback and support! This update adds depth, new challenges, and lays the foundation for even more to come.

Good luck out there… and brace yourself for Neptune!

notes.title: Chaotic Update – BRICKS SURVIVORS
notes.content:
🔥 New Features

Added three new chaotic equipment items:

 🌀 Chaotic Pistol
 🌀 Chaotic Turret
 🌀 Chaotic Cannon


Bring chaos to your runs with these powerful new tools! 💥
Leaderboard can now be filtered by Steam friends, making it easier to compare your performance with your circle of players. 🏆

⚖️ Balancing & Improvements


 Increased the level cap for certain upgrades, allowing for more progression and customization. 🔧
 Increased the amount of PA gained at the end of a run based on the score, making runs more rewarding. 
 Various UI adjustments for better readability and a smoother experience.


Unleash the chaos and enjoy the update! 🚀

notes.title: Patch Notes 01.31.2025 – BRICKS SURVIVORS Balance Update
notes.content:
Score System Adjustments
[olist]
Revision of the score earned when clearing the screen:
 Previously, the score gained was exponential, leading to large disparities between players. This resulted in cases where some players defeated more bosses but were still not ranked first.
 Now, the score awarded is fixed and scales based on difficulty, ensuring a fairer and more balanced ranking system.
 ⚠️ As a result of this adjustment, the annual leaderboard will be reset. However, the January leaderboard will remain unchanged.
[/olist]

Nerfs
Equipment
     Increased cooldown for the Shield equipment:

 Level 1: 25s → 30s
 Level 2: 20s → 25s
 Level 3: 15s → 20s
 Level 4: 10s → 15s
 Level 5: 5s → 10s

Boosts
      Reduced chance for missiles to double fire:

 Level 1: 15% → 10%
 Level 2: 30% → 20%
 Level 3: 45% → 30%
 Level 4: 60% → 40%
 Level 5: 75% → 50%

Missiles

 Reduced AOE damage of missiles:
 Missile explosions now deal 50% of base damage instead of 100%.

 Level 2: 1.75s → 1.5s

notes.title: Patch Notes - 01/18/2025
notes.content:
Fixes

Yellow Armor:

 The yellow armor no longer charges during the transition phases between survival and boss fights.
 Fixed a bug where selecting the yellow armor caused issues when the power bar was fully charged.

These updates ensure a smoother and more consistent gameplay experience. 🎮

notes.title: Update Notes - January 11, 2025
notes.content:
Balancing:

Nerfed cannon equipment to adjust their power and improve overall game balance.
Bug Fixes:

Fixed several minor bugs to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.
Thank you for your feedback and continued support! 🚀

notes.title: 🌟 New and final BRICKS SURVIVORS demo update! 🌟
notes.content:
The BRICKS SURVIVORS demo reaches its final version with this latest update. 
On the program: 
4 new missions that extend the gameplay experience, numerous tweaks and polishes for a smoother feel, and brand-new content. 
From now on, you can unlock exclusive new equipment directly in the demo, as well as a new “bullet time” upgrade to spice up your games. Try out this new version now and immerse yourself in the enhanced world of BRICKS SURVIVORS !
